<style>
.quiz {
  border: 1px solid #2F7A6D;
  background-color: #EDF6F4;
  border-radius: 4px;
  margin: 1em 0 1.5em;
  padding: 0.9em 1.1em 1.1em;
}
.quiz::before {
  content: "❓\0000a0\0000a0Quick check";
  display: block;
  color: white;
  font-weight: 600;
  padding: 0.4em 0.9em;
  margin: -0.9em -1.1em 0.75em -1.1em;
  border-radius: 3px 3px 0 0;
  background-color: #2F7A6D;
}
.quarto-dark .quiz { background-color: #12241f; border-color: #4FA391; }
.quarto-dark .quiz::before { background-color: #1F5548; }
.quiz-question { margin-bottom: 0.6em; }
.quiz-choices {
  list-style: none;
  padding-left: 0;
  margin-bottom: 0.7em;
}
.quiz-choices li.quiz-choice {
  cursor: pointer;
  padding: 0.4em 0.7em;
  margin-bottom: 0.35em;
  border: 1px solid var(--bs-border-color, #ccc);
  border-radius: 4px;
  background-color: var(--bs-body-bg, #fff);
  transition: background-color 0.15s ease, border-color 0.15s ease;
}
.quiz-choices li.quiz-choice:hover {
  background-color: #F0F0F0;
}
.quarto-dark .quiz-choices li.quiz-choice:hover {
  background-color: #24413a;
}
.quiz-choice.correct {
  background-color: rgba(25, 135, 84, 0.18);
  border-color: #198754;
}
.quiz-choice.incorrect {
  background-color: rgba(220, 53, 69, 0.18);
  border-color: #dc3545;
}
.quiz-feedback {
  padding: 0.5em 0.7em;
  border-radius: 4px;
  margin-top: 0.5em;
}
.quiz-feedback-correct { background-color: rgba(25, 135, 84, 0.15); }
.quiz-feedback-incorrect { background-color: rgba(220, 53, 69, 0.15); }
</style>

<script>
(function () {
  function setFeedback(container, correct, text) {
    const feedback = container.querySelector(".quiz-feedback");
    if (!feedback) return;
    feedback.hidden = false;
    feedback.textContent = text;
    feedback.className = "quiz-feedback " + (correct ? "quiz-feedback-correct" : "quiz-feedback-incorrect");
  }

  function shuffle(array) {
    for (let i = array.length - 1; i > 0; i--) {
      const j = Math.floor(Math.random() * (i + 1));
      [array[i], array[j]] = [array[j], array[i]];
    }
    return array;
  }

  function initQuizzes() {
    document.querySelectorAll(".quiz").forEach(function (quiz) {
      const list = quiz.querySelector(".quiz-choices");
      const choices = Array.from(quiz.querySelectorAll(".quiz-choice"));
      if (list) {
        shuffle(choices.slice()).forEach(function (c) { list.appendChild(c); });
      }
      choices.forEach(function (choice) {
        choice.addEventListener("click", function () {
          choices.forEach(function (c) { c.classList.remove("correct", "incorrect"); });
          const correct = choice.dataset.correct === "true";
          choice.classList.add(correct ? "correct" : "incorrect");
          setFeedback(quiz, correct, choice.dataset.explain || (correct ? "Correct!" : "Not quite — try again."));
        });
      });
    });
  }

  if (document.readyState === "loading") {
    document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", initQuizzes);
  } else {
    initQuizzes();
  }
})();
</script>
